answer: New identities must gather nectar: each real job earns one nectar credit from its counterparty, posted to a mirror ledger reflecting every claim. A new identity locks a 75,000 POA bond and starts hollow - no nectar, no large trades - until three credits fill it. A mirror audit each epoch checks credits against counterparty logs; fake nectar burns the bond, half to the reporter, the identity banned 13 epochs. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 75,000 = 75,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one 75,000 POA bond once. The limit: counterparties can collude to issue fake nectar.
